text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening position and repeated \"I am for driveless cars\" stance","quality":"stance clarity","description":"The essay states its position more explicitly and returns to it throughout, so the reader never loses track of where it stands."},{"evidence":"mentions environment, health problems, safety, accidents, liability","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay develops several lines of reasoning instead of relying on one or two brief points."},{"evidence":"body paragraph on safety and accident responsibility","quality":"argument elaboration","description":"It expands claims with explanation and consequences, showing more depth in how the reasons connect to the position."},{"evidence":"references sensors, vibrating seats, Google car warnings, flashing lights","quality":"source integration","description":"The essay uses more specific details from the article to support its claims and make the argument feel better grounded."},{"evidence":"counterargument paragraph beginning \"Although having the positives...\"","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges drawbacks and discusses them directly rather than mentioning opposition only briefly."},{"evidence":"conclusion restates reasons and weighs pros and cons","quality":"organization","description":"The essay has a more developed overall structure with clearer movement from introduction to body discussion to conclusion."}]}
